description: Employee with wages exactly at the Social Security wage base.
worked:
One employee, one employer, wages 176,100 in 2025.
Social Security (OASDI) employee tax: 2025 wage base 176,100; wages subject = smaller of 176,100 and 176,100 = 176,100 (wages are at the base); 6.2% x 176,100 = 10,918.20.
Medicare (hospital insurance) employee tax: no wage base; 1.45% x 176,100 = 2,553.45 (the 0.9% additional Medicare tax is figured on Form 8959 with the return, not here).
